name: posterract
description: Edit the active Posterract video project through its local canvas, timeline, source, media, validation, capture, and export tools.

interface.shortDescription: Control the active Posterract canvas from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Posterract connects Codex to the video project currently open in Posterract Desktop. It can inspect and edit source-backed canvas elements, control the timeline, validate compositions, inspect media, capture frames, and export locally.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the Posterract tools to inspect the active project before editing. Validate meaningful changes and inspect captures before claiming the visual result is correct.
